culprit_citations.quoted_text: Pushpay USA Inc. (4)(5)(6) | Unitranche First Lien Revolver | 05/2029 | - | ( 12 | ) | - | ( 3 | )

findings.detail: The source Pushpay revolver row presents cost as (12) and fair value as (3) in thousands, but the extracted row has cost +12000 with fair value -3000.
The flagged source position is a revolver and Pushpay also appears in the unfunded commitments table, so the extracted row lost the unfunded/revolver context.

rationale: C103 fired because the extracted row has fair_value -3000 with positive cost 12000 and no unfunded-commitment marker. Raw source table 10 row 24 shows the same Pushpay revolver with both cost and fair value in parentheses, i.e. cost -12000 and fair value -3000 in source scale, and table 19 row 6 identifies Pushpay as a revolver unfunded commitment. The negative fair value is source-present, but the extracted row's cost sign and revolver/unfunded context are wrong, so this is a real extraction/normalization error rather than a false alarm.
